summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 2, 2026, attaching an ASX Appendix 3Y notice regarding a change in director's interest. The filing discloses that non-executive director Ashok Belani indirectly acquired 757 ordinary shares through the Non-Executive Directors Share Plan trustee on August 27, 2026, at $32.0406 per share. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of a director share purchase under an existing share plan, not a special situation. No corporate transaction, strategic review, or other special-situation event is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer current report.
